claim_quality_summary.claim_basis: Layer 2 gold packet rows from docs/research/wubrg, captured official/current sources, and source-generated governance.
claim_quality_summary.support_material_policy: Commander rows, MTGDecks, Archidekt, Scryfall support queries, local essays, and deck links may appear only as bounded support or discovery material.
claim_quality_summary.evidence_quality: High for Commander color-identity rules, source/generated boundary, exact Maze query contract, and no-preview lifecycle; medium for Vox Mana synthesis and five-color mechanics texture; support-only for Commander deck rows and external deck browsing.
known_limitations: WUBRG is not an official faction, plane, civilization, guild, college, or single doctrine.

Draconic Domination and Painbow are verified only as support-only deck/product rows after VM-368; they do not support lore, legality, popularity, ranking, metagame, or representative play-pattern claims.
Named-card legality and exact Oracle claims require current manual verification.
Scryfall broad five-symbol Oracle query results are discovery/support only.
No popularity, price, metagame, or cEDH claims are authorized.

claims.statement: WUBRG / Five-Color is approved for controlled Layer 1 promotion only after Layer 2 gold readiness; it is placeable and dossier-visible but not Home-preview, public-route, or Crucible-expanded.
claims.canon_status: Vox Mana lifecycle and public-interface boundary

evidence_locations.bounded_paraphrase: The repository guardrail requires source-owned evidence before generated promotion and forbids generated/runtime output from becoming semantic evidence.
VM-367 authorizes controlled WUBRG placement and dossier visibility while preserving route, directory, and then-current preview restrictions.

claims.notes: Product governance only. Not MTG lore, rules, legality, or deck evidence.

claims.statement: In Commander, a WUBRG commander gives the deck access to White, Blue, Black, Red, and Green color identity at the deck-construction level.

evidence_locations.bounded_paraphrase: The official Commander format page ties deck construction to the commander's color identity, including mana symbols in the commander.
The audited WUBRG packet applies the Commander color-identity rule to the all-five-color WUBRG deck-construction lane without making named-card legality claims.

claims.notes: Does not recommend a named commander or imply current legality without a dated card/source check.

claims.statement: WUBRG grants full deck-level color access, but individual cards and effects remain bounded by their own rules text, color identity, and color-pie context.

evidence_locations.bounded_paraphrase: The official design article describes mechanical capabilities and restrictions as color-specific design boundaries.
The audited packet distinguishes deck-level access to every color from the rules text, identity, and color-pie bounds of individual cards.

claims.notes: Do not claim WUBRG erases color-pie limits.

claims.statement: Five-Color is the preferred public label, WUBRG is the technical/internal code, and Vox Mana must not present WUBRG as a single official faction, plane, civilization, guild, college, or doctrine.
claims.canon_status: Vox Mana naming policy with official product-label support

evidence_locations.bounded_paraphrase: The official Commander product article uses Five-Color and the White-Blue-Black-Red-Green expression as product/deck labeling.
The audited packet treats WUBRG as technical shorthand, prefers Five-Color in public copy, and rejects presenting it as one official faction or doctrine.
The repository audit inventories the full-spectrum WUBRG slot as a structural combination and records naming/interpretation limits.

claims.notes: Vox Mana may use synthesis language, but it must stay clearly non-canon.

claims.statement: Domain, converge, sunburst, WUBRG costs or activations, multicolor payoffs, and basic-land-type checks are usable discovery texture for Five-Color play patterns when specific card claims are manually verified.

evidence_locations.bounded_paraphrase: The audited packet lists full-spectrum and multicolor mechanics as WUBRG texture while requiring card-level verification and refusing to treat search results as proof.
The reference audit inventories mechanics that care about multiple colors while retaining explicit notes and boundaries.

claims.notes: Broad query results are discovery/support only until reviewed card by card.

claims.statement: WUBRG Commander and precon rows may be shown as support-only deckbuilding navigation when local row, commander identity, product name, and official/current decklist source agree.

evidence_locations.bounded_paraphrase: The repository contract separates authoritative semantic evidence from support/navigation material and generated output.
VM-367 permits Commander/deck/search links as bounded support while prohibiting unsupported recommendation, legality, and public-surface expansion.
The audited packet permits Commander context as navigation and deckbuilding texture but does not promote it into lore, legality, popularity, or placement proof.

claims.notes: Not lore proof, legality proof, popularity proof, ranking proof, metagame proof, representative play-pattern proof, or placement proof. Draconic Domination and Painbow were verified under VM-368 as support-only deck rows.

claims.statement: WUBRG must remain distinct from Colorless, five-color Eldrazi-as-Colorless claims, four-color missing-color frames, generic goodstuff-only framing, superiority or total mastery claims, universal-superset claims, endpoint/completion claims, and default high-complexity-answer claims.

evidence_locations.bounded_paraphrase: The repository dossier separates all-five-color inclusion from Colorless non-coloration and warns against rank, mastery, or branch conflation.
The audited packet explicitly rejects official-faction, superiority, universal-doctrine, goodstuff-only, and unverified named-card claims.
The repository contract bars generated, support-only, and discovery material from becoming authoritative semantic proof.

claims.notes: Boundary claim only. Do not infer Colorless or four-color lore from WUBRG support material, and do not make WUBRG the default answer for breadth or complexity.

claims.statement: Official WUBRG Commander product and decklist anchors may support named examples, deck/product texture, and source coverage only; they do not by themselves support color philosophy, metaphysics, lore proof, placement proof, legality, popularity, ranking, metagame, or deck-quality claims.

evidence_locations.bounded_paraphrase: The repository contract requires authoritative source ownership and prohibits support or generated material from padding semantic proof.
The audited packet treats official products and named decks as examples and navigation, not as independent proof of WUBRG philosophy, legality, popularity, or quality.
The reference audit retains interpretation and source limitations around five-color examples and mechanics.

claims.notes: Use this claim to keep WUBRG product examples useful but narrow. Stronger lore or philosophy claims require an explicit source saying the stronger thing.
